elements.label: Flyout submenu content swaps from Integration Management list to Reports list (scrollbar appears)
elements.change_other: instant content swap (hard replace of submenu items)

elements.label: Reports menu row becomes active (dark highlight)
Integration menu row loses its active highlight

pattern.description: In a zoomed screen recording, hovering a left-nav item instantly swaps the flyout submenu to that section's items while the active-row highlight moves from Integration to Reports.
pattern.why_premium: Keeping the native, instant UI response on a zoomed, legible menu reads as authentic product proof; the swap lands on 'source systems' so the navigation path follows the narration.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set(integrationRow, {backgroundColor: navBase}).set(reportsRow, {backgroundColor: navActive}).set(submenuIntegration, {autoAlpha: 0}).set(submenuReports, {autoAlpha: 1}) at the same time (no tween); optionally gsap.fromTo(submenuReports, {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.08, ease: 'none'}) for a softer swap.
build_hint.remotion: Hard switch on one frame: const showReports = frame >= swapFrame; render the Reports submenu and active-row styles conditionally (no interpolate or spring).

notes: The cursor already sits on Reports at the burst start and does not visibly move, so it is not listed. The swap is a one-frame hard change (energy spike on a single frame).
